title: Fixed-power local closure for the PAH-OMC-013 generator intertwining
question: Does the unchanged PAH-OMC-013 support rule extend the one-step generator identity to every fixed generator power after an explicitly growing support threshold N_k(f)?

fixed_scope.model: Exactly PAH-001 and the PAH-OMC-013/OMC-004 strip root catalog; no new carrier, rate, state, projection, counterterm or time interpretation.
fixed_scope.comparison: The original pointwise pullback I_(n,n+1) and the same finite backward generators used by R-493.
fixed_scope.support_rule: For a finite cylinder support C, one generator application enlarges support by the declared finite root support radius; iterate k uses the recursively enlarged C_k.
fixed_scope.order: This is a fixed-k finite algebra statement only. It does not exchange k with n, take j or n limits, or identify a target process.
fixed_scope.time: The original external stochastic Markov time remains unchanged; no quantum, proper or Lorentzian interpretation is used.

conditional_statement: If the R-493 one-step identity holds for every finite-support function in the recursively enlarged cylinder class, then for each fixed k the power identity L_(n+1)^k I f = I L_n^k f holds whenever n >= N_k(f). For the ell_(0,0) support in the frozen strip, the derived worst-case closure has column maximum 2k and N_k=max(2,2k+1).

finite_checks.root_radius: The OMC-013 root catalog has maximum core-to-support column radius 2 on the cofinal strip.
finite_checks.ell_a_closure: Starting from {(0,0)}, the conservative support closure reaches both rows in columns 0,...,2k after k steps.
finite_checks.threshold: N_k=max(2,2k+1) separates the k-step closure from the split terminal frontier.
finite_checks.boundary_witness: The existing R-551 second-order defect at n=3 is compatible with n<N_2; the same frozen sample has zero second-order defect at n=5, consistent with the sufficient threshold.

decision_rule.PASS_CONDITIONAL: Use only for the fixed-k finite locality implication and its exact support audit.
decision_rule.HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE: Keep the PAH-OMC-020 ordered objective open because no uniform-in-k tail, common-space packet, N2b/N2c/N4 estimate or R-512 identification follows.
decision_rule.NEGATIVE_RESULT: Use only if the unchanged root catalog violates the derived closure/threshold or the frozen R-551 witness contradicts the stated separation.
